hypothesis: TRAIN-learned compact causal separator coordinates retain sufficient information for exact delayed-intervention prediction in hidden-state worlds with novel structural grammars and variable entity counts; relative to equally TRAIN-informed optimized full-state bitset/transition-map controls, learned projection reduces complete CPU at nonregressing peak RSS or yields more certified sound answers.
innovation: Learn sparse state-coordinate separators for future-intervention targets across time and graph structures, with exhaustive per-grammar proof of sufficiency for every latent state, independent graph-mode label, intervention and query. Absent an exact proof, fall back to the full exact counterfactual map. Unlike T28's dictionary of recurring masks, the learned object is a compact Markov-sufficient causal projection, not a memorized posterior or Boolean truth table.

sources.scope: two distinctly NEW internal causal grammars, not randomized instances of T28's old grammar
sources.F: 7-entity directed competing mediator graph, two parents, XOR/NAND latent transition
sources.G: 9-entity feedback graph, three parents, majority/parity latent transition
sources.future_counterfactual: 2 transitions, first intervention only, 3 target answers

mechanism.TRAIN_only: Select target/intervention/graph-specific bit coordinates by greedy public TRAIN predictive dependency frequency, allowing fallback to full state. Coordinates may be encoded only if universally sufficient for the exact future target under that graph-mode/action; never use private graph label or hidden ground truth in learner fitting.
mechanism.exact_global_proof: For each proposed projected key and every possible n-bit current latent state, recompute the two-step exact causal response and ensure all states with the same coordinate key produce identical target bit. If not, reject that proposed projection; exact fallback applies. This proof uses the declared public causal grammar, never private source labels.
mechanism.inference: Update complete unpruned exact graph-mode state bitsets over all masked observations. For each future target, apply certified compact projected posterior masks where available; otherwise run optimized exact full-map bitsets. Every possible graph/mode/state must agree before certification.
mechanism.no_data_leakage: TRAIN only for feature ordering, no DEV to select projection, no actual source hidden true topology/mode/initial state as model input.

pre_DEV_admission.headroom: at least 20% and at most 85% genuine unresolved future target questions in TRAIN, not a cherry-picked DEV threshold

original_prospective.strict_scientific_improvement: Higher exact certifiable coverage than every equally TRAIN-informed exact control with zero hard false positives and no complete CPU/RSS regression, OR identical certified coverage with strictly lower complete CPU and no peak RSS regression against strongest trained/deterministic controls
original_prospective.complete_cost: Includes source generation, learned fitting, global proof, exact fallback, all hidden-state inference, scoring
